description: What a cleaning business should charge for a standard recurring house cleaning, from the home size and the cleaner pay. Returns the recommended flat price per visit, the time it takes and the cost breakdown (labor, supplies, overhead, profit). Use when a cleaner or cleaning business owner asks how much to charge to clean a house. Defaults are typical US numbers; pass a state for that state’s minimum price.

bathrooms.description: Number of bathrooms; 2.5 for two full and a half bath.

hourlyWage.description: What the cleaner is paid per hour, in dollars. Default 22.

overheadPct.description: Overhead as a percentage of the price. Default 25.

profitPct.description: Profit margin as a percentage of the price. Default 15.

sqft.description: Home size in square feet. Left out: estimated from bedrooms.

state.description: US state name or code, to add that state’s minimum price from local cleaner wages.

name: price_house_cleaning
title: House cleaning price calculator
